# ankra_ai_ticket_settings (Resource)

The organisation's AI ticket desk settings (`ankra tickets settings`): the Slack channel and Microsoft Teams conversation tickets are announced in, the reviewing agent, which insight severities are filed automatically, and the channel notification policy. There is one per organisation. Only the attributes set in configuration are written; an unset attribute keeps the stored value (or the default) and reports it. Changing the settings needs an organisation admin. Destroy leaves the settings as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_ticket_settings" "desk" {
  slack_channel_id             = "C0123456789"
  require_agent_review         = true
  auto_file_insight_severities = ["critical", "high"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_file_insight_severities` (Set of String) Insight severities filed as tickets automatically.
- `notify_cluster_environments` (Set of String) Cluster environments whose tickets the channels are notified about.
- `notify_event_scope` (String) Which ticket events the channels are notified about.
- `notify_min_priority` (String) Lowest ticket priority the channels are notified about.
- `notify_mode` (String) When the channels are notified about tickets.
- `notify_source_kinds` (Set of String) Ticket sources the channels are notified about.
- `require_agent_review` (Boolean) Whether a ticket needs the reviewing agent's review.
- `reviewer_agent_task_id` (String) Agent task that reviews tickets.
- `slack_channel_id` (String) Slack channel tickets are announced in.
- `teams_conversation_id` (String) Microsoft Teams conversation tickets are announced in.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `ai_ticket_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one per organisation; any id imports it.
terraform import ankra_ai_ticket_settings.desk ai_ticket_settings
```
